unit.explanation: Eleven donor-patient/PDO correlation cases were evaluated.

platform.explanation: Drug responses were measured in patient-derived organoids.

readout.explanation: Most PDO calls used normalized AUC; HO17 and HO42 used published IC50 criteria.

direction.explanation: Lower AUC or IC50 indicated greater sensitivity.

threshold_rule.explanation: Jenks Natural Breaks assigned sensitive, intermediate, or resistant PDO response.

threshold_timing.explanation: Response categories were formed from the PDO AUC values being compared.

patient_mapping.explanation: The image table maps individual HO PDO identifiers to donor responses; structured transcription is required when OCR is unavailable.

regimen_match.explanation: Matched therapies were used where available, with documented drug-substitution and HO20 exceptions.

n_units.explanation: The reported denominator is 11 paired patient/PDO cases.

split.explanation: This was a retrospective paired agreement analysis rather than held-out model validation.

headline.blocked_reason: The 11 row-level Table 1 observations are available only as jciinsight-7-158060-g063.jpg; parsed article Table 1 has zero rows and local OCR did not yield all 11 HO-ID/match rows. An independent read_figure transcription is required for each patient ID, RECIST outcome, PDO response category, and Match/Mismatch result.

notes: The article reports 9 of 11 (82%) concordant cases and names HO42 and HO140 as the two mismatches in article:p24.
